head: fb2ab535b7728948f7106108e6a6faaba1974a4e
review_scope: Only pending train.py, test_comparison.py, build_colab.py and comparison.py changes for the v0.5.1 numerical fix and log surfacing; no wider refactor audit.
verdict: No actionable substantive issue found in the exact reviewed fix.

checks.detail: Both directions remain KL(second||first) and KL(first||second), averaged by one half, with class sums and batchmean reduction. CE remains average of the two example-mean CEs. Replacing probability targets with log targets changes numerical evaluation, not the intended objective.

log_softmax supplies finite negative log probabilities for the reported finite extreme logits. log_target=True evaluates exp(target_log)*(target_log-input_log), so it avoids the logarithm of an underflowed zero probability in target-side differentiation. Neither direction is detached or clamped, preserving both gradient paths. This directly addresses the reported probability-target derivative failure; it is not a claim of finiteness for already-NaN/Inf input logits.

The alpha=0 branch returns CE itself, rather than CE+0*KL. The independently computed KL diagnostic is detached before accumulation and is not reachable from loss.backward(). Computing KL for diagnostics does not introduce a backward path into that loss.

Nonfinite dev logits are rejected before argmax/metrics. Nonfinite macroF1, accuracy or dev loss are rejected before appending history, changing callback.best or saving a checkpoint. Valid finite dev values retain the same selection_key rule. No test-selection input or fallback candidate is introduced.

Extreme float32 logits explicitly induce softmax zeros; alpha0 and alpha1 loss/gradients are checked against a float64 reference with non-underflowing probabilities at these chosen magnitudes. Separate injected-NaN diagnostic test verifies exact CE return and absent KL backward dependency. Nonfinite dev tests verify rejection before history/candidate publication. Existing symmetry/batch-scale and train/eval/reload tests remain present.

Stdout is drained before pipe close/wait, child nonzero exit prints the saved diagnostic tail and still raises RuntimeError. Full child output remains in its log; no failed condition can continue into method selection.

v0.5 default names remain unchanged; v0.5.1 generates distinct v051 archive/runtime/result names. Coordinator output is drained to comparison.log, errors surface the captured tail, and nonzero coordinator exit raises instead of printing success. open(x) preserves the fresh-run requirement.
comparison.log is optional for direct/script fixtures and included in the normal existing hash/archive collection when present. It does not alter model selection or acceptance eligibility.
Parsed current Python source with ast.parse only; did not import or execute project modules.

preserved_boundaries: Existing one-pass ordinary CE evaluation branch is unchanged.
Dev-only epoch/LR/primary/method selection, deferred evaluation ordering and regression-only test acceptance policy are untouched by the scoped diff.
No seed/LR/dropout/data/label/prompt hyperparameters changed in the reviewed diff.
This review did not edit experiments/v0.5, experiments/v0.5.1, shared source, data or weights.

execution_limits.statement: The exact fix is supported by static reasoning and reviewed regression assertions. Parent owns their execution and subsequent T4 validation; a successful new Colab training run was not observed here.
